subject: Network isolation, SOC 2 status & evidence — clarifications and next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acuvera.com>, security@acuvera.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Network isolation, SOC 2 status & evidence — clarifications and next steps

Emily / Acuvera security team — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap of the items we discussed and the concrete asks so we can move the private deployment evaluation forward: 

Summary notes from the call:
- Acuvera is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC-hosted) for PHI workloads and want predictable isolation + strong auditability.
- You indicated SOC 2 Type II is in progress (target Q3 2028) and that you can share an interim bridge letter / Type I report.
- HIPAA BAA is required for Protected Health Information — you are open to signing (said you will confirm with legal).
- Initial preference seems to be VPC peering for integration; air-gapped/on-prem option possible for higher-risk pipelines.

Action items / asks from Redwood (what we need from you to qualify options):
1) SOC 2 evidence: please share latest Type I report or bridge letter and any expected completion date for Type II. Preferred delivery: SFTP or secure Drive link.
2) Vendor questionnaire: please complete the attached vendor security questionnaire (redwood-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx) and return — this helps our Security Ops map controls.
3) Network posture: please provide a network diagram (vlan/CIDR blocks), proposed ingress/egress rules, and an estimate of steady-state and burst throughput (tokens/sec or MB/s). If you already have a diagram, please attach.
4) Data residency: confirm US region(s) required and any regulatory constraints.
5) BAA: status / timeline for signature.

Proposed next steps & timeline:
- If you can share SOC 2 artifacts + completed questionnaire by EOD 2028-06-16, our Security Ops (Lauren & Sean) will do an initial mapping and get back within 3 business days with any follow-ups.
- If network looks straightforward, we can scope a VPC-peering proof-of-concept in your account (no air-gap) to validate throughput. If air-gapped is required, we'll outline the on-prem packaging and an evidence checklist.

Please find the vendor questionnaire attached. If SFTP is your preferred delivery method for sensitive docs, share creds or an upload path and we will pull the artifacts.

Thanks — looping in Monica (account lead) and Lauren (security lead) to coordinate the assessment.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Network isolation, SOC 2 status & evidence — clarifications and next steps

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. Great to align on next steps. Answers inline below and attachments included.

SOC 2 / Compliance:
- We completed SOC 2 Type I in Dec 2027; Type II is currently in progress with an expected issuance date of 2028-08-15.
- We can provide the Type I report today and a bridge letter outlining the Type II timeline.
- HIPAA: Acuvera is comfortable executing a BAA; legal is prepping a standard form, estimating signature within 2 weeks.

Network posture / architecture:
- Attached: acuvera-net-20280612.pdf (high-level network diagram) and acuvera-initial-answers.csv (quick table with CIDRs & throughput estimates).
- CIDR ranges: 10.10.0.0/16 (internal), 172.31.0.0/16 (services), public egress via NAT through 34.210.0.0/16.
- Estimated steady-state egress for the model proxy: ~60 MB/s (peaks ~200 MB/s during batch runs).
- Current preference: VPC peering for initial integration to simplify routing and monitoring. We may request an air-gapped/private deployment for the most sensitive PHI ingestion path; need to see your evidence checklist to scope that work.

Artifacts delivery:
- We prefer SFTP for SOC artifacts (sftp://files.acuvera.com/incoming). I will ask security@acuvera.com to open a folder with creds.

We are attaching the diagram and a short CSV with the network/CIDR/throughput values. Let us know if you need more detail (subnet-level, firewall rules).

Best,
Emily Stone
Director, Platform Engineering — Acuvera Health
emily.stone@acuvera.com | +1 617-555-0199

Emily — perfect, this is very helpful. Thank you for the artifacts. Two quick items from our side: 

1) Vendor questionnaire: Monica, can you please own the intake and send the HubSpot/Redwood questionnaire link to Acuvera? Emily — I’ve attached the same questionnaire here for convenience, but please complete the web form at https://redwood.hubspot.com/forms/vendor-security so we can track it to the ACV-2783 record.

2) Evidence transfer: we will accept the SOC Type I and bridge letter via your SFTP. Please share creds when ready and cc security@redwood.com. If you prefer, you may also upload to the Drive link we sent in the wiki.

Lauren & Sean (security): initial ask is to map the Type I and the network diagram to our evidence matrix and flag any gaps relative to our private deployment guidance. Expect a follow-up in 72 hours. If a BAA is needed before peering, note that in the HubSpot task so Legal can prioritize.

Proposed short timeline: artifacts + questionnaire by EOD 2028-06-16 -> initial mapping by 2028-06-19 -> POC scoping call week of 2028-06-24. Will that work on your side?

Thanks — Rishi
